definitions.gloss: to drink together; to exchange drinks
definitions.explanation: To share drinks with someone, typically alcoholic beverages, in a convivial setting. Implies a mutual, social act of drinking.

examples.japanese: {旧友|きゅうゆう}と{杯|さかずき}を{飲|の}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I shared cups of sake with an old friend.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}が{更|ふ}けるまで{仲間|なかま}たちと{飲|の}み{交|か}わしながら、{昔話|むかしばなし}に{花|はな}を{咲|さ}かせた。
examples.english: We drank together with friends until late at night, chatting happily about old times.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{飲|の}む (to drink) + {交|か}わす (to exchange, do mutually). The {交|か}わす element gives the verb its sense of shared, reciprocal action.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the drink: {酒|さけ}を{飲|の}み{交|か}わす

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {酒|さけ}を{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to drink sake together
- {杯|さかずき}を{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to share cups of sake
- ワインを{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to drink wine together

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and warm in tone. Often appears in descriptions of bonding, reunions, and celebrations. In casual speech, {一緒|いっしょ}に{飲|の}む is more common.

OTHER ～{交|か}わす VERBS:
- {言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす: to exchange words
- {約束|やくそく}を{交|か}わす: to make a promise with each other
